crossRefs.note: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself, and to God.

translations.web: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself, and to God.
translations.bsb: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.
translations.kjv: But if ➔ there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
translations.asv: but if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
